Why Ondo Chain’s Layer 1 Blockchain is the Key to Efficient Real-World Asset Tokenization

by Jones
March 22, 2025


The financial landscape is undergoing a massive transformation with the rise of blockchain technology. One of the most exciting innovations emerging from this revolution is asset tokenization. This concept, once seen as a futuristic idea, is now a tangible reality, reshaping how we invest, manage, and trade real-world assets. Whether it’s real estate, fine art, or commodities, tokenization turns these physical assets into digital tokens on a blockchain, making them easier to trade and more accessible to a wider range of investors.
How Ondo Chain’s Layer 1 Solution Sets Itself Apart
Ondo Chain is a blockchain built specifically to support the tokenization of real-world assets. Its Layer 1 structure offers distinct advantages that make it stand out in the rapidly evolving world of blockchain-based finance:

Institutional-Grade Security and Compliance: Ondo Chain’s platform combines the transparency of public blockchains with the regulatory compliance features of permissioned chains, making it suitable for institutional investors who demand higher security standards.
Tailored for RWAs: Unlike general-purpose blockchains, Ondo Chain is optimized for the tokenization of physical assets, with built-in features that cater to the unique needs of real-world assets.
Validator Participation and Data Accuracy: Ondo Chain allows validators not only to confirm transactions but also to ensure the accuracy of financial data, such as asset prices and token values. This added layer of trust is crucial for institutional participants.

The Need for Blockchain Technology in Real-World Assets (RWAs)
Blockchain technology addresses many of the challenges faced by traditional asset management systems. When it comes to RWAs, blockchain provides several advantages:

Efficiency and Speed: Traditional methods of asset transfer involve numerous intermediaries and can take days or even weeks to complete. Blockchain, by eliminating middlemen, speeds up the process, allowing transactions to be completed in real-time.
Greater Transparency: Blockchain’s decentralized nature means all transactions are publicly available and verifiable. This eliminates the potential for manipulation or fraud, giving participants the confidence that their investments are secure.
Reduced Costs: By removing intermediaries like brokers, lawyers, and financial institutions, blockchain significantly reduces transaction costs. This makes it more affordable for individuals and companies to invest in tokenized assets.

Decoding Layer 1 Blockchains: The Foundation of Blockchain Solutions
What Is Layer 1 and Why Does It Matter?
Layer 1 refers to the base blockchain protocol, where all transactions and data are stored directly on the main chain. It’s the foundation upon which everything else is built and ensures that the blockchain network is secure, scalable, and efficient. Unlike Layer 2 solutions, which rely on a main chain for processing, Layer 1 blockchains handle everything natively.
How Layer 1 Blockchains Enable Faster and Safer Transactions
Layer 1 blockchains are the most secure and scalable part of the blockchain ecosystem. By directly processing transactions on the base layer, they ensure that transactions are recorded quickly and securely, without relying on secondary protocols or chains that may add latency or vulnerabilities.
Key Advantages of Layer 1 Solutions for Businesses and Investors

Security: Layer 1 blockchains are inherently secure, as they leverage consensus mechanisms such as Proof of Stake (PoS) or Proof of Work (PoW) to ensure that data on the network is accurate and tamper-proof.
Scalability: A well-designed Layer 1 blockchain can handle a large volume of transactions, making it suitable for businesses and investors who need a platform that can scale with their growing needs.
Decentralization: By distributing control across multiple validators, Layer 1 blockchains prevent the concentration of power in a single entity, offering a more resilient and fair system for asset tokenization.

Exploring Ondo Chain: The Blockchain for Real-World Asset Tokenization
In decentralized finance (DeFi), Ondo Chain emerges as a pivotal player, offering tailored solutions for the tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs). By bridging traditional finance with blockchain technology, Ondo Chain aims to transform how we perceive and interact with asset tokenization.​
What Makes Ondo Chain the Perfect Fit for Asset Tokenization?

Institutional-Grade Infrastructure: Designed with institutional investors in mind, Ondo Chain combines the openness of public blockchains with the compliance and security features of permissioned chains. This hybrid approach ensures that tokenized RWAs meet the stringent requirements of traditional financial markets.
Native Support for RWAs: Ondo Chain provides seamless integration for tokenized RWAs, ensuring that assets like government bonds, corporate bonds, and real estate are efficiently managed within the blockchain ecosystem. ​
Validator Participation and Data Accuracy: Validators on Ondo Chain not only confirm transactions but also verify critical financial data, such as asset prices and proof of reserves, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.  

Core Features and Benefits of Ondo Chain’s Layer 1 Blockchain

High-Quality Asset Staking: Validators can stake RWAs and other high-quality liquid assets to secure the network, bridges, and oracles. This mechanism reduces volatility risk and costs while enabling investors to earn additional yield on their RWAs. ​
Enshrined Oracles & Proof of Reserves: Through consensus, validators automatically verify key off-chain data, such as asset prices and proof of reserves, ensuring trusted and real-time updates. ​
Seamless Investor Experience: By tightly coupling on-chain and off-chain infrastructure, Ondo Chain reduces costs, enhances security, and ensures low-latency operations for critical processes, meeting the user experience expectations of institutional-grade financial markets. ​

A Deep Dive into the Ondo Chain Ecosystem and Its Capabilities

Omnichain Bridging: Ondo Chain features advanced bridging capabilities, facilitating secure and efficient asset transfers between Ondo Chain and other supported blockchain networks, thereby enhancing liquidity and interoperability. ​
Validator Participation: Validators in Ondo Chain play a crucial role in maintaining the integrity of the network by participating in consensus mechanisms and ensuring the accuracy of financial data, such as asset prices and proof of reserves.
Asset Manager Tools: Ondo Chain provides asset managers with tools to create and manage omnichain RWAs effectively, bridging traditional asset classes with blockchain technology and enhancing the efficiency of asset management processes. ​

How Ondo Chain is Revolutionizing the Tokenization of Real-World Assets
By offering a blockchain platform specifically designed for RWAs, Ondo Chain addresses the unique challenges of tokenizing traditional assets. Its features cater to the needs of institutional investors, ensuring that tokenized assets are secure, compliant, and efficient.​
Real Estate, Commodities, and Other Assets: A Blockchain-Enabled Future

Real Estate: Ondo Chain enables the tokenization of real estate properties, allowing for fractional ownership and increased liquidity in the real estate market.​
Commodities: By tokenizing commodities, Ondo Chain facilitates efficient trading and investment in commodity markets, enhancing accessibility for a broader range of investors.​
Diverse Asset Classes: Beyond real estate and commodities, Ondo Chain supports the tokenization of various asset classes, including government and corporate bonds, providing investors with diversified investment opportunities.​

Bridging Traditional Asset Classes with Blockchain Technology
Ondo Chain serves as a bridge between traditional asset classes and blockchain technology, offering solutions that address the unique challenges of tokenizing traditional assets. This integration enhances efficiency, liquidity, and accessibility in asset management.​
Key Use Cases for Ondo Chain in Asset Tokenization and Their Impact

Cross-Border Investment: Ondo Chain’s omnichain bridging capabilities enable investors to access and invest in tokenized RWAs across different blockchain networks, expanding investment horizons.​
Enhanced Liquidity: By facilitating the tokenization of RWAs, Ondo Chain enhances liquidity in traditionally illiquid markets, such as real estate and commodities, providing investors with more flexible investment options.​
Efficient Asset Management: Asset managers can leverage Ondo Chain’s tools to efficiently create, manage, and trade tokenized assets, streamlining operations and reducing costs.​

The Technology Behind Ondo Chain: The Power of Layer 1
Ondo Chain’s Layer 1 blockchain is designed to provide a secure, scalable, and efficient platform for asset tokenization. Its architecture ensures that transactions are processed quickly and securely, meeting the demands of institutional investors.​
Consensus Mechanism: Ensuring Trust and Security
Ondo Chain utilizes a proof-of-stake consensus mechanism, where validators stake their assets to participate in the network’s consensus process. This mechanism ensures that only trustworthy participants validate transactions, maintaining the integrity and security of the network. ​
High Transaction Throughput and Low-Latency for Fast and Efficient Tokenization
Designed for high transaction throughput and low latency, Ondo Chain ensures that tokenization processes are fast and efficient, meeting the needs of institutional-grade financial markets. ​
The Role of Smart Contracts and Decentralized Apps in Enhancing Asset Tokenization
Smart contracts and decentralized applications (dApps) on Ondo Chain automate processes and enhance functionality, making asset tokenization more efficient and accessible. These technologies enable programmable transactions and decentralized finance applications, expanding the possibilities of asset management.
Advantages of Ondo Chain’s Layer 1 Solution for Asset Tokenization
Ondo Chain’s Layer 1 blockchain offers a suite of features designed to address the unique challenges of real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, making it a pivotal player in the evolution of decentralized finance (DeFi).​

Fractional Ownership: By converting RWAs into digital tokens, Ondo Chain facilitates fractional ownership, allowing investors to own a share of high-value assets like real estate or art. This approach democratizes investment opportunities, enabling participation with lower capital requirements. ​
Enhanced Market Liquidity: Tokenizing assets on Ondo Chain transforms traditionally illiquid investments into liquid digital tokens, streamlining buying, selling, and trading processes. This increased liquidity attracts a broader investor base, including those seeking short-term investment opportunities. ​

Lowering Barriers: Fractional Ownership and Access for More Investors

Global Accessibility: Ondo Chain’s blockchain infrastructure ensures that tokenized assets are accessible to investors worldwide, transcending geographical limitations and fostering a global investment community. ​
Regulatory Compliance: Designed with institutional standards in mind, Ondo Chain incorporates permissioned validators and compliance features, ensuring that tokenized assets adhere to global regulatory frameworks, which is crucial for attracting institutional investors. ​

Enhancing Security: A Blockchain Approach to Transparent and Secure Transactions

Immutable Ledger: All transactions on Ondo Chain are recorded on an immutable ledger, ensuring data integrity and transparency. This feature enhances trust among investors and stakeholders, as transaction histories cannot be altered or tampered with. ​
Validator Accountability: With a network of permissioned validators, Ondo Chain ensures that only approved entities validate transactions, reducing the risk of fraudulent activities and ensuring that asset valuations and transactions are accurate and trustworthy. ​

Improving Efficiency: Reducing Costs and Intermediaries in Asset Transactions

Lower Transaction Costs: By eliminating intermediaries such as brokers and clearinghouses, Ondo Chain reduces transaction fees, making asset transfers more cost-effective for investors and institutions alike. ​
Streamlined Processes: The automation of asset transfers and settlements through smart contracts minimizes delays and operational inefficiencies, leading to faster transaction times and improved overall market efficiency. ​

Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs): Ondo Chain supports the creation and management of NFTs, enabling the tokenization of unique assets such as collectibles, art, and intellectual property. This feature opens new avenues for artists, creators, and collectors to monetize and trade digital assets. ​

Future Integration with Emerging Technologies for Advanced Asset Tokenization

Cross-Chain Compatibility: Ondo Chain’s omnichain bridging functionality ensures that tokenized assets can move seamlessly between Ondo Chain and other supported blockchains, enhancing liquidity and accessibility across different platforms. ​
Integration with Traditional Financial Systems: By aligning with existing financial infrastructures, Ondo Chain facilitates the smooth transition of traditional assets into the blockchain space, promoting wider adoption and integration of blockchain technology in mainstream finance. ​

Ondo Chain envisions a future where a significant portion of global assets are tokenized, creating a more efficient, transparent, and accessible financial ecosystem. This vision includes:​

Universal Asset Accessibility: Making a diverse range of assets available to investors worldwide, fostering a more inclusive financial environment.​
Enhanced Economic Efficiency: Reducing transaction costs and times, leading to a more dynamic and responsive global economy.​
Strengthened Financial Stability: By incorporating real-world assets into the blockchain, Ondo Chain aims to create a more resilient financial system less susceptible to traditional market volatilities.​

Fostering Environmental Sustainability through Blockchain Solutions

Energy-Efficient Consensus Mechanism: Ondo Chain utilizes a proof-of-stake consensus algorithm, which significantly reduces energy consumption compared to proof-of-work systems, aligning with global efforts to combat climate change. ​
Carbon Offset Initiatives: The platform supports initiatives aimed at offsetting carbon emissions generated by blockchain operations, contributing to global sustainability goals.​

Sustainable Asset Management: By integrating eco-friendly practices into its asset tokenization processes, Ondo Chain ensures that investments not only yield financial returns but also contribute positively to environmental sustainability.​
Green Investment Opportunities: The platform offers investors opportunities to engage in green projects and sustainable asset classes, promoting environmental responsibility within the investment community.​

In Brief Ondo Finance is expanding tokenization applications by moving to the Solana blockchain. The integration enhances USDY's effectiveness across various blockchain networks. This move could positively impact Solana's and ONDO's market performance.
Ondo Finance has announced its transition to the Solana $149 blockchain to expand its tokenization applications aimed at digitizing real-world assets. The company is focusing on employing solutions like USDY to establish a suitable infrastructure for institutional usage, thereby facilitating asset transfer.
Ondo Finance’s Expansion
Through integration with Solana’s decentralized validation network, Ondo Finance is able to connect systems based on the Proof-of-Stake model with compatible networks such as Ethereum $1,823 , Arbitrum, and Mantle. With assets worth $170 million on the platform, USDY is now poised for more effective use across various chains due to the new integration.
Ondo Finance stated, “The new bridge facilitates USDY transfers efficiently, enabling asset mobility without additional capital requirements.” This strategic move aims to significantly enhance the operational scope of USDY across different blockchain environments.
Effects on Solana and ONDO Prices
This integration is expected to have positive effects on the market performance of Solana and ONDO native tokens. An increase in product demand from institutional investors is seen as one of the steps that will support the liquidity flow to the platform. The efficiency brought about by the technology may contribute to bolstering current market dynamics.
In recent months, Ondo Finance has partnered with institutions such as World Liberty Financial to support its tokenization strategies. These efforts have seemingly paved the way for the ONDO token to gain attention and appreciate in market value. The new integrations are conceptualized to diversify the existing investment options and enhance the use of digital assets.
The evolving integration process points to the potential for increased efficiency in asset transfers across different chains. Innovations in technological infrastructure are likely to attract the interest of institutional investors and positively influence expectations for solution models provided by platforms. Market fluctuations, along with innovations brought by the integration, are being closely watched by investors.
These developments provide significant contributions to the digitalization process of the sector, creating new opportunities for investors searching for alternative solutions. The steps taken by Ondo Finance are considered exemplary in providing efficiency in digital asset transfers. Technological integrations aligned with market demands are expected to be utilized more in the coming periods.

By J. Razo
In the rapidly evolving world of decentralized finance (DeFi), strategic alliances often serve as catalysts for groundbreaking innovations. One such partnership poised to redefine financial ecosystems is between Zebec Network (ZBCN) and Ondo Finance (ONDO). This collaboration is not just another DeFi integration–it’s a bold move that aims to revolutionize real-time payroll systems and cross-border remittances. By merging Zebec’s continuous payment technology with Ondo’s USDY stablecoin, the two powerhouses are setting the stage for a financial revolution that could take the world by surprise.
The Synergy of Zebec and Ondo
Zebec Network is at the forefront of transforming financial transactions through its blockchain-based platform, designed to facilitate seamless, real-time payments. Unlike traditional payment systems that rely on batch processing, Zebec enables continuous, per-second payment streams. This capability has already gained traction in payroll processing, subscription services, and on-chain payment infrastructures, empowering businesses and individuals to manage their finances with unprecedented efficiency.
Enter Ondo Finance, known for its robust USDY stablecoin that offers a reliable, secure, and efficient method of digital transactions. The integration of USDY into Zebec’s payment ecosystem is a strategic move that enhances stability while maintaining high transaction speeds. By combining Ondo’s financial expertise with Zebec’s real-time payment solutions, this partnership is set to streamline financial operations on a global scale. The result? Reduced reliance on traditional banking intermediaries and a more decentralized, efficient financial system.

The Zebec-Ondo collaboration is more than just a technological integration–it’s a visionary approach to solving longstanding challenges in payroll processing and cross-border transactions. Imagine a world where employees are paid by the second, where freelancers receive payments in real-time, and where international remittances are instant, transparent, and cost-effective. This is the future that Zebec and Ondo are building together.
By leveraging the stability of USDY, Zebec can enhance its continuous payment streams, ensuring that users experience but also broadening the scope of applications for DeFi technologies. With Zebec’s innovative infrastructure and Ondo’s trusted stablecoin, the partnership is paving the way for a new era of global finance–one that is fast, reliable, and borderless.
Market Reception and Future Outlook.
The market is already buzzing with anticipation. As of February 17, 2025, Zebec Network’s token (ZBCN) is trading at $0.00157747, reflecting a 0.27% increase from the previous close, with an intraday high of $0.00163684. Similarly, Ondo’s token (ONDO) is priced at $1.29. These numbers reflect growing investor confidence in the potential of this partnership to deliver transformative financial solutions.
Looking forward, the Zebec-Ondo alliance is positioned to set new standards in the DeFi space. Their combined strengths in continuous payments and stablecoin integration are expected to revolutionize how businesses and individuals conduct financial transactions. As they continue to innovate and expand their services, all eyes are on the dynamic duo, anticipating the next wave of financial disruption.
Why This Matters: A Financial Revolution in the Making.
The partnership between Zebec Network and Ondo Finance is not merely about improving payment systems–it’s about creating a paradigm shift in global finance. By addressing existing financial challenges with innovative blockchain technologies, they are not only enhancing user experiences but also contributing to the broader evolution of the financial industry.
In a world where financial inclusion and efficiency are more critical than ever, Zebec and Ondo are leading the charge toward a decentralized, transparent, and user-centric financial ecosystem. As the world watches in anticipation, one thing is clear: Zebec Network and Ondo Finance are set to take the world by surprise.

What is the Ondo Foundation?
The Ondo Foundation (formerly known as the Neptune Foundation) was founded in 2022 as an independently governed and nonprofit Cayman Islands Foundation Company with no beneficial owners. The Ondo Foundation assisted in the launch of the Ondo DAO, which deployed and currently governs Flux Finance, the first lending protocol supporting tokenized securities as collateral.

What is the Foundation's mission?
The Ondo Foundation has a mission of democratizing access to institutional-grade finance. We are focused on supporting decentralized protocols like Flux, participating in the Ondo DAO community and, more recently, supporting tokenized real world assets like USDY.  
Notably, the Ondo Foundation, through its subsidiaries, owns 99% of the common equity in Ondo USDY LLC, the issuer of USDY. The Ondo Foundation therefore benefits from the growth of USDY and uses proceeds from this growth in furtherance of its mission.

On which key areas does the Foundation focus?
Ondo Foundation’s mandate is focused on several key areas:

Supporting Innovation: Financing and endorsing projects that responsibly advance the adoption of tokenized real world assets and their use in onchain financial protocols.
Educating and Promoting Awareness: Increasing public understanding of our ecosystem and the benefits of asset tokenization.
Treasury Management: Overseeing a treasury to facilitate strategic ecosystem growth.
Contract Deployment: Issuing governance tokens and deploying protocol smart contracts.
Web Application Management: Hosting web applications for certain platforms in the ecosystem.
Strategic Partnerships and Engagement: Collaborating with businesses, regulators, and other stakeholders.
Intellectual Property Management: Acquiring and handling IP rights.
Community Events and Engagement: Organizing events to strengthen community ties.

The Ondo Foundation also works with Ondo Finance as a commercial partner that is focused on the provision of certain technology and business development services and the management of certain tokenized real world assets like USDY.

What is the ONDO Token?
In mid-2022, Ondo Foundation, through its subsidiaries, sold ONDO tokens to over 18,000 individuals through CoinList. ONDO token holders are entrusted with shaping the future of the Ondo DAO so that it continues to pursue its mission to democratize access to institutional-grade finance. The Ondo DAO gives ONDO holders specific rights pertaining to Flux Finance, which is currently governed by the Ondo DAO.

What is the Ondo Ecosystem?
The Ondo Ecosystem encompasses the full set of partners working with or affiliated with the Ondo Foundation that are aligned with the mission of bringing institutional-grade financial products and services to everyone. Contributors to the Ondo Ecosystem include developers, educators, researchers, partners, and strategic contributors.
